name: Flame Layer Balm
text:
Activate 3 (manipulate)

---
Slathering this reddish-gold balm over a suit of armor creates a swirling pattern of flame-like licks and curls. The balm remains on the armor for 1 hour, and the first time during that time that the wearer takes fire damage, the balm bursts into flame and the wearer gains the effects of the Fiery Body spell for 1 minute.
